body:
### Problem
The dependents route (`tasks::api`) doesn't check the task ID. Other task routes answer 400 for a malformed ID and 404 for an unknown one. This one answers 200 with an empty list, so a mistyped or out-of-date link shows "Needed by: nothing" instead of an error.

### Done when
- The dependents route answers 400 for a malformed ID and 404 for an unknown one, like the other task routes.
- Tests cover both, and a known task with no dependents still gets an empty list.
title: tasks: dependents list checks the task ID
